card.name: Pronouns that refer back to a definition
card.fires_on: The words that, this and which right after a definition or description, where they start a clause or sentence that comments on what was just described.

modes.label: Relative clause opener
modes.description: "that" or "which" begins a clause after a comma, adding more about the thing just named.
modes.example: opportunistic viral infection of the brain caused by the JC virus (JCV) that typically only occurs in patients who are immunocompromised, and<< that>> usually leads to death or severe disability.

modes.label: Sentence-start This
modes.description: "This" opens a new sentence that refers back to the condition or term just defined.
modes.example: Galactorrhea is a discharge of milk-like substance from the breast that is not associated with breastfeeding after pregnancy.<< This>> condition mainly occurs in women.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mixed set with no clear link, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "this" or "which" that point back to a thing the text has just explained.
